import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    students = []
    idx = 1
    
    for i in range(n):
        name = data[idx]
        m1 = int(data[idx + 1])
        m2 = int(data[idx + 2])
        m3 = int(data[idx + 3])
        total = m1 + m2 + m3
        average = total / 3.0
        students.append((name, m1, m2, m3, total, average))
        idx += 4
        
    print("-" * 50)
    header = "Name".ljust(10) + "M1".rjust(5) + " " + "M2".rjust(5) + " " + "M3".rjust(5) + " " + "Total".rjust(7) + " " + "Average".rjust(8)
    print(header)
    print("-" * 50)
    
    for student in students:
        name, m1, m2, m3, total, average = student
        line = name.ljust(10) + str(m1).rjust(5) + " " + str(m2).rjust(5) + " " + str(m3).rjust(5) + " " + str(total).rjust(7) + " " + f"{average:.2f}".rjust(8)
        print(line)
    
    print("-" * 50)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
